quarterly_data.signal: Polyamide 6 (release): BASF SE and Highsun Holding Group (HSCC) signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding to explore combining their European activities across the polyamide 6 (PA6) value chain in a 50:50 joint venture, and are evaluating the inclusion of their global extrusion activities outside North America; the engineering-plastics downstream businesses are not in scope, and project teams have been set up. Chairman of the Board of Executive Directors Markus Kamieth: the combination 'would strengthen our competitive position through improved asset utilization and lower costs'. BASF produces polyamides in Ludwigshafen, Antwerp, Caojing and Freeport, Texas.
